mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sal_yt_customer_store WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sal_yt_customer_store WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM sal_yt_customer_store WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND warning_number >= store_number AND warning_number > 0

select sycs.location_id,syl.name as location_name from sal_yt_customer_store as sycs left join sto_yt_location as syl on syl.id = sycs.location_id where sycs.id = #{specificationId} and sycs.is_deleted=0

SELECT sycs.*, (select name from sto_yt_location where id = sycs.location_id ) as locationName, (select code from pro_yt_product where id = sycs.product_id ) as productCode from sal_yt_customer_store as sycs WHERE sycs.id = #{id} AND sycs.is_deleted = 0
